diagnosis: Customer rotated their IdP signing certificate without updating the metadata URL on our end, which is the classic cause of assertion errors in SSO. Account has SSO entitlement on business plan with standard support.
reply: Thank you for reporting this. The assertion error you are seeing is typically caused by the metadata not being updated after rotating your identity provider certificate. Please re-upload your current metadata following the steps in our guide, then test with a single account before re-enabling enforcement. If the issue persists, let us know.
